---
# Federal (USAJOBS) resume. Includes grade, hours, and supervisor (from
# private.yml) for every role, plus credit hours for each degree.
title: ""
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    includes:
      in_header: ../assets/preamble.tex
  word_document: default
geometry: margin=0.6in
fontsize: 10pt
mainfont: Carlito
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "..", "R", "cv.R"))
cv <- load_cv()
```

```{r}
render_header(cv)
```

# Summary

```{r}
cat(esc(squish(cv$profile$summary$federal)), "\n\n")
```

# Professional Experience

```{r}
render_experience(cv, max_priority = 2, federal = TRUE,
                  compact = c("fwri", "uf-lab", "nestwatch"))
```

# Education

```{r}
render_education(cv, federal = TRUE)
```

# Awards and Recognition

```{r}
render_awards(cv, max_priority = 1, amounts = FALSE)
```

# National Service

```{r}
render_simple(cv$service$national)
```

# Publications

```{r}
render_pub_line(cv)
```
